title: Leadership and management professional
change: Occupational standard and assessment plan revised
overviewOfRole: Leadership and management professionals guide organisations and lead teams towards achieving their goals and agreed outcomes.

knowledges.detail: Principles, theories and models for developing and implementing organisational strategy
The impact of ethical and sustainable decisions on strategic planning and organisational decision making
Strategies for internal and or external stakeholder engagement and management
Factors impacting the changing and future landscape of workforce management for example, multi-generational workforces, hybrid working and automation
Strategic approaches to workforce management for example  recruitment, performance management, reward, talent management, resource planning and leading teams
Approaches to monitoring and managing individual and team health and wellbeing
Leadership approaches and models in different situational and organisational contexts
The roles of leaders as coaches, mentors and managers of conflict and challenge
Approaches to managing and developing self as an inclusive leader
Approaches to developing and influencing organisational culture and the principles of equity, equality, diversity and inclusion
Theories and approaches to inspire, motivate and manage people across the performance range
Approaches to setting goals and measuring performance at individual and team levels
Theories and strategies to organisational and team communication.
Approaches to adapting communication for different audiences and situations.
Importance of values, ethics and culture in approaches to organisational governance
Organisational key regulatory and statutory requirements
Factors which affect risk strategies, how to develop decisions that balance innovation, business continuity and risk mitigation.
Approaches to creation, implementation and evaluation of organisational processes, policies and procedures
Project lifecycle, including how to lead and manage teams to deliver outcomes aligned to organisational goals and strategy
Approaches, models and metrics for proposal development and project management
Models of change and innovation, how to overcome barriers to change and best practices in leading through uncertainty
Techniques to develop resilience in self and others
Models or principles of continuous improvement including the use of metrics and technology to lead improvement activities
Principles of data analysis, evaluation and communication to support management decision making
Approaches to digital innovations and frontier digital technologies, their impact and how their application can be used for organisational improvement and development
Practical and cultural considerations of embedding new technologies and the risks or controls which these may present.
Methods to interpret and analyse financial and resource management information to make informed management decisions
Approaches to calculation of metrics to support proposals and projects (such as use of labour, return on investment, cash flow requirements)
Approaches to sustainability into organisational practices and how to measure progress.

behaviours.detail: Role models ethical behaviour and values
Demonstrates transparency, honesty and integrity in working interactions
Values and enables a diversity of views to support decision making
Operates collaboratively, leads by example and encourages and facilitates co-operation.
Enables learning opportunities and continuous professional development for self and others

skills.detail: Develop and execute organisational strategies, plans and projects in line with ethical and sustainable practices
Lead individuals and teams to deliver organisational strategy, goals and projects
Collaborate within the organisation and create purposeful alignment to overall strategic direction
Influence and manage stakeholder relationships by using tools and frameworks to assess and enhance engagement and impact
Negotiate and challenge in order to drive strategic outcomes
Evaluate current and future workforce needs, applying equality, diversity and inclusion principles
Input to or influence the organisation's strategic workforce plan or talent management processes to build capability and talent.
Demonstrate leadership and management best practices, for example relationship building, adapting approaches and managing conflict and challenge
Demonstrate approaches to foster collaboration that promotes an inclusive organisation culture
Use coaching and mentoring theories and approaches to support the achievement of individual and organisational objectives
Set, measure and manage individual or team objectives and performance to achieve organisational goals
Develop and implement open and multi-directional communication across the team
Use and evaluate channels, tools and techniques to meet and adapt to internal and external stakeholder needs
Make recommendations to develop the strategies that support risk mitigation, contingency planning and organisational resilience
Collaborate with stakeholders to identify or implement improvements to organisational processes, policies and procedures
Lead strategic projects, inspiring and motivating individuals and the team to achieve key performance indicators
Drive and deliver improvements or growth in organisational process, product or service
Lead through change and transformation to achieve organisational strategy and objectives
Apply problem-solving techniques, identifying opportunities, and making informed recommendations that enhance organisational outcomes
Use data visualisation and analysis tools to inform or influence the team and organisation to make evidence-based decisions.
Evaluate current and emerging technologies and make recommendations that consider ethics and risks, aligned with organisational policies
Apply commercial acumen to manage resources and make effective financial decisions
Develop and embed the sustainability agenda within the area of responsibility, reviewing and or improving current policies and practices, delivering progress against targets and KPIs

involvedEmployers:
Nestle, Greencore, NHS England, Cancer Research, Lloyds Bank PLC, Morrisons, GXO, Salutem, The Rugby Players association, AJ Bell, University Hospitals Sussex NHS Foundation Trust, NSPCC, Turning Point, EasyJet, Jet2, Amazon, W H Smith, British Army, DVSA, Deloitte, CMI. 
City & Guilds (ILM), Corndel, Manchester Metropolitan University,

reviewDetails: this apprenticeship will be reviewed in accordance with our change request policy.
clusterDescription: Leader of a business process and/or unit requiring the ability to analyse and improve complex business-wide processes and risks. Also includes the ability to provide a full range of company legal and financial knowledge relevant to running a company
banners: New starts on this apprenticeship are not government funded from 1st September 2026. Any apprentice who started this apprenticeship before 1st September 2026 will continue to be funded through to completion. This apprenticeship remains available for delivery for privately funded apprentices

duties.dutyDetail: Develop ethical and sustainable solutions which meet strategic organisational and stakeholder needs
Develop and manage strategic relationships with internal and external stakeholders to enable organisational delivery
Shape and drive current and future workforce development throughout the employee lifecycle within scope of the role
Lead, manage and motivate individuals and teams to achieve organisational outcomes
Shape and influence organisational culture to achieve equity, diversity, inclusion and belonging principles
Empower and support individuals and the wider organisation to achieve objectives
Drive a culture of open, multi-directional and effective communication
Drive and implement organisational compliance, governance, regulatory and statutory requirements in own area of responsibility
Own, manage and mitigate risks related to area of responsibility
Engage with wider organisation to enhance ways of working, policies and procedures to ensure they are fit for the future of the organisation
Collaborate across the organisation to lead or deliver projects in alignment with organisational strategic priorities
Drive innovation and change to deliver impactful outcomes for the organisation
Lead a culture of continuous improvement and excellence within your area of the organisation
Drive the collation, analysis and communication of relevant data to inform and influence evidence-based strategic decisions to improve team capability and performance
Role model the use of current and emerging technologies to drive forward organisational capabilities, creating more efficient and effective ways of delivering impactful outcomes
Interpret financial information and its impact to make informed management decisions
Role model leadership to drive the sustainability agenda, inspiring advocacy, innovation and continuous improvement
